expected_structural_delta: No new owner, service, store, or configuration key. One provider hook is renamed to plural and returns a list; one helper is extracted from lifecycle_tick.
minimum_design: The GitHub lifecycle hook scans all slots once per tick and returns every confirmed exit; lifecycle_tick replaces each one and still rechecks the exact owner immediately before replacement. Confirmation counting stays one increment per tick.
outcome: When several runner slots exit between lifecycle ticks, every confirmed slot is replaced in that tick, so a burst of short jobs does not leave slots empty for one 30-second tick each.

reuse_decisions.name: lifecycle_tick and cmd_recycle
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing tick already owns replacement under the fleet lock; only its one-per-tick limit changes.

reuse_decisions.name: LIFECYCLE_CONFIRMATIONS marker files
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing per-slot confirmation stays. Calling the hook repeatedly in one tick would double count, so the hook returns all names in one pass instead.

reuse_decisions.name: LIFECYCLE_INTERVAL
reuse_decisions.rationale: The interval stays at 30 seconds. The change removes the serial limit only.
